Subject: Re: Download labels broken in Oct 29 Google Code Site update.


I would like to second the report of the problems with labels, I can't
change or add new ones like before.  This problem was happening for me
before the downtime, but I figured that eventually it would work its
way out.  Hopefully a little more time will do it.

I haven't tried the uploads yet, so I can't confirm that.

-Bryan

On 10/29/07, Graham Dumpleton  wrote:
>
> Seems the update last night might have broken a few things. Problem is
> that one of the things that may have broken is the FAQ entry at
> http://code.google.com/hosting/faq.html referenced from project
> hosting group welcome page. As a result, cant find the issues tracker
> for codesite problems, something which never seems to be listed in an
> obvious place. :-(
>
> Anyway, until I can find the issue tracker again, posting here to note
> that download labels seem to have been broken. If you have an existing
> entry and go in and try and change the labels, one would normally see
> a drop down list of choices if not all categories applied. This
> doesn't appear and click enough times and it will display a message:
>
>   Note: You are using 2 uncommon labels.
>
> It seems that of the labels:
>
>   Type-Source OpSys-All Featured
>
> it only recognises Type-Source as valid.
>
> All the labels in Adminstrator/Downloads area are as they were
> originally and haven't been changed.
>
> Happens on Firefox and Safari.
>
> Also had a file upload take forever at one point with proxy in between
> finally timing out. Google Code wouldn't show it in list but wouldn't
> let me replace it, but then about 10 minutes later it finally showed
> up. So uploads having problems as well.
>
> Graham
